scope: Macro-expanding CBFS LES reader; DASimpleFoam primal on CBFS; timed adjoint pilot on CBFS (design-variable and objective substituted, disclosed); stage 4 gated on stage 3

stage1_macro_reader.problem: Ofpp.parse_internal_field returns None (no exception) on CBFS 0/U_LES etc. because those files use #include + $name macro substitution that Ofpp's line scanner does not resolve
stage1_macro_reader.second_bug_found: 0/p_LES has a duplicate 'internalField' key: a placeholder 'uniform 0' BEFORE the #include block, legitimately shadowed (OpenFOAM last-entry-wins) by the real macro'd value AFTER it. A naive macro-expand-then-rescan approach reproduces Ofpp's first-match bug as a silently WRONG (not missing) value. Fixed via an explicit last-wins entries dict.

verification.roundtrip_method: synthesized a #include+$name macro'd file from CBFS's own 0/U inlet boundary data (150 vectors, already Ofpp-parseable with no macros), parsed via macro reader, compared np.array_equal (exact) against plain-Ofpp ground truth on the same numbers

p_LES.note: was silently 0.0 (placeholder shadowing bug) before the duplicate-key fix

case_fixes_applied.cause: DAFoam DASimpleFoam wrapper unconditionally reads these even without an energy equation
case_fixes_applied.fix: added Pr 0.7, Prt 1.0 (standard air, matches lab's naca0012 case); inert for momentum/turbulence equations solved

case_fixes_applied.issue: 2D empty-type frontAndBack patch not supported by DAFoam mesh warping (IDWarp)
case_fixes_applied.cause: DACheckMesh fatal error: 'Mesh geometric directions is less than 3 and not supported'
case_fixes_applied.fix: converted frontAndBack from empty to symmetry in polyMesh/boundary and 0/{U,p,k,omega,nut}; declared both z-planes via meshOptions symmetryPlanes; standard DAFoam 2D workaround, same pattern as lab's naca0012 case

case_fixes_applied.issue: primalBC.useWallFunction:True forcibly overrides CBFS's real wall BCs
case_fixes_applied.cause: confirmed via log grep: BCType changed nutLowReWallFunction->nutkWallFunction, k fixedValue 1e-15->kqRWallFunction; a genuine physics change, not solver noise
case_fixes_applied.fix: primalBC: {} (no override); rejected after measuring 19% field deviation with the override active
case_fixes_applied.measured_impact_of_bug: up to 19% k-field scaled MAE vs B2 baseline with the override active

case_fixes_applied.cause: surfaceScalarField on a symmetry patch requires explicit 'value' entry, unlike volField symmetry
case_fixes_applied.fix: deleted 0/phi; OpenFOAM recomputes it from U at solver start (standard, most cases ship no initial phi)

reproduction_vs_b2_converged_field.comparison_note: B2's own cross-solver-family agreement (OpenFOAM-7 orig vs our v2606 reproduction, plain OpenFOAM, no DAFoam) was 0.068% for CBFS U. Our DAFoam-vs-plain-OpenFOAM U agreement (0.087%) is comparable; p/k/omega are 3-20x looser, plausibly from DAFoam-bundled v2506 vs our plain-OpenFOAM v2606 point-release gap plus AD-instrumented solver internals -- not further decomposed this rung.

primal_cost_measured.config: warm IC (B2 field), run_model, to tol 1e-6
warm IC + patchV-perturbed inlet, to tol 1e-6

design_variable_substitution.actual_paper_dv: spatially-varying beta(x) field multiplying SST omega destruction term, via a custom OpenFOAM turbulence library not distributed in the public benchmark clone (documented in B2)
design_variable_substitution.justification: adjoint linear-solve cost is dominated by one transpose solve of the residual Jacobian (sized by full state vector), structurally independent of which design variable's sensitivity is requested
design_variable_substitution.disclosed_side_effect: overwrites CBFS's real nonuniform inlet profile with a uniform one, for this pilot only; stage 2's reproduction check used a separate script with no design variable and real BCs untouched

objective_function.reference_field: 0/UData, written from CBFS's own macro-resolved LES U_LES field (stage 1 output)
objective_function.leakage_status: none -- CBFS is the paper's training case, not a scored test case

second_silent_failure_found.bug: DAFunctionVariance hardcodes reading reference data from literal folder '0' regardless of the case's actual startFrom/startTime. With startFrom=latestTime and stray intermediate time dirs on disk, DAFoam's parallel auto-decomposition (-np 4) only decomposed the run's actual start time, never '0', so processorN/0/UData did not exist.
second_silent_failure_found.symptom: DAFunctionVariance printed a WARNING and silently used isRefData_=0, giving functionValue=0.0 exactly and an all-zero adjoint RHS; GMRES 'converged' in 0 iterations with a fake zero residual
second_silent_failure_found.caught_by: checking the printed objective value ([0.]) and grepping the WARNING rather than trusting the reported success
second_silent_failure_found.fix: forced startFrom=startTime, startTime=0; cleared all stray intermediate time directories so decomposition always covers '0'

blocker.symptom: PETSc KSPConvergedReason = -9 (DIVERGED_NANORINF) at GMRES iteration 0, nonzero initial residual (~7.1e-4) but zero actual iterations completed

reproduced_across.result: diverged reason -9, residual 7.0916e-4 (nearly identical to run 5's 7.099e-4)

reproduced_across.objective: force (CD), standard type proven in naca0012 case

ruled_out: custom objective function specifics (standard force objective fails identically)
shallow ILU fill level (fill level 4 fails identically)
mesh quality (DACheckMesh: max aspect ratio 14.76, max non-orth 33.3deg, max skewness 0.26, all well within thresholds and reported OK)

adjoint_coloring_onetime_cached.note: measured once before the reference-data bug was found; cached to dRdWColoring_4.bin afterward

drdwtpc_jacobian_partial_derivative_matr.note: recurs per adjoint call; same run as coloring measurement

gmres_linear_solve_itself.reason: solver never completes a single iteration due to the DIVERGED_NANORINF blocker; this is the dominant, iteration-count-scaling cost B1 flagged as the key unknown

stage3_timed_adjoint_pilot.implied_total_inversion_cost: cannot be honestly estimated -- B1's 140-420 core-minute range assumed the GMRES solve executes; with zero measured GMRES iterations, extrapolation would be fabricated. Fixed per-call overhead alone (~13-38s per call at 4 ranks, before any GMRES iteration) is consistent with, but does not confirm, B1's lower bound.

stage4_full_inversion.reason: correctly gated by stage 3's unresolved adjoint blocker, per docket instruction

memory.peak_rss_measurement_bug: docker-stats-based sampler had a race condition (checked container-running state before docker run had finished creating the named container), captured zero data points across 6 attempts
memory.concurrent_load: 2-3 other DAFoam agents + mega-batch process running throughout

ground_truth_read.reason: CBFS is the paper's field-inversion training case, explicitly not one of the 8 scored closure-challenge test cases
ground_truth_read.used_for: stage 1 macro-reader verification; writing 0/UData as the stage 3 adjoint pilot's reference field

ground_truth_read.note: our own B2-produced converged plain-OpenFOAM baseline, not LES ground truth; used to warm-start the DAFoam primal (stage 2) and as the stage-2 comparison target

leakage_statement.note: No duct compute was run this rung at all -- stage 4, the first point at which duct data could legitimately enter for final forward scoring only, did not run.
